reviewer: AI assistant; no independent human coding
unit_definition_en: An actionable step or identifiable risk cue, retaining conditions that affect implementation; not a completely independent overarching strategy.
decision_rule_en: Merge when the action, target, and materially relevant conditions are the same; changes in wording, platform examples, or data fields are not separate units. Include tool-use limitations within the same unit where possible.

Early declarations of destiny are part of rapid emotional escalation, not a separate unit.
Both concern seeking trusted professional technical assistance after device compromise.
Copying a link is an implementation of preserving a content address.
Links, timestamps, and account identifiers belong to the same communication-evidence bundle.
Chat records and profile information belong to the same relationship-communication evidence bundle.
Contact identifiers belong to the same relationship-communication evidence bundle.
Threat content is preserved within the evidence bundle, rather than counted as a separate unit by message content.
Both concern preserving relationship communications before blocking; the order of actions is retained.
Repeated incidents and background are recorded in the communication-evidence bundle, not counted separately.
Wallet addresses are payment evidence, retained with dates, amounts, and transaction identifiers.

excluded_keys.reason_en: Excluded: general risk budgeting for legitimate investment is insufficiently related to romance-scam prevention.

retained_distinctions.reason_en: These respectively concern ending contact after suspected fraud, pausing contact during verification, and blocking renewed contact; the action stages differ.
General principles and payment-channel-specific recipients or procedures are retained separately; they are not claimed to be independent overarching strategies.
The checks respectively concern account history, cross-account consistency, image identity, and text scripts; the actions differ.
General anomaly checks, forwarding-rule removal, session revocation, and recovery-credential repair are different security actions.
The former recommends screening before meeting; the latter explains that live video can also be fabricated. The action and evidentiary limitation differ.
Payment information, login credentials, one-time verification codes, and wallet recovery keys involve different permissions and protective actions.
These respectively concern permission to receive evidence, respect for refusal to talk, and support for recovery after fraud.
These address different tool limitations: modified versions, differences between video and thumbnail formats, and new files that cannot be added to an existing case.

lexical_pair_review.method: Token-IDF cosine >= 0.28; lexical retrieval only, not embedding similarity
